ruling.explanation:
Your two accounts agree on more than either of you allows, and the numbers decide it. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if, among other things, the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 300 seconds - the TRANSPORT_HUB minimum - and that clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00209, COMPLETE at weight 1.0: 108 fixes at a 10 s cadence, max_gap_sec 0.0, both tracks present) credits a single qualifying hold of 236 seconds, opening 07:44:14 and ending when the driver cancelled at 07:48:10 - 64 seconds short of the 300 second minimum. The trip record's 10.1 minute wait is measured from the 07:38:05 arrival marker, which POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-05 do not accept as starting the clock: the first qualifying fix is 369 seconds after that marker, so dwell_start_offset_sec of -369 confirms the run opens at 07:44:14. Limb (b) fails too, because there is no qualifying in-geofence fix at or before 07:38:05. POL-NS-06 therefore governs: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, with no driver compensation payable, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. Accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) does not rescue the driver - the trace shows one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to sum, and the required traffic advisory is absent (EV-ADVIS-00209-01, MISSING, weight 0.0) - and POL-NS-06(ii) confirms an advisory would never lower the minimum in any event. POL-NS-05's false-arrival machinery is not made out either way: the record publishes no distance or speed at the 07:38:05 marker, so a false-arrival referral does not fire, and in any case qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist in the trip. The SGD 6.00 is in fact already refunded: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00209) records payment_status REFUNDED and refund_issued_sgd 6.00, and 6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so the ledger reconciles and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists. This dispute is driver-filed, so the outcome is party-relative: NO_ACTION means the present state stands and the rider remains refunded. The fee is not restored, and the drivers' request to claw it back is refused. On the rider's side, POL-NS-04 does not apply - she sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window, so limb (a) is unmet - but it changes nothing, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee on the shortfall alone. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00209) is down-weighted to 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: both driver messages and the system notice carry null read receipts, consistent with the rider's account that she saw nothing until afterwards. It does not carry the deciding dwell fact, so it does not cap confidence, and it supplies no extra seconds - the 64 second shortfall still stood 230 seconds after the last message at 07:44:20. On POL-NS-07, compensation is unavailable because it is conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full; the anti-farming check is never reached (3 no-show terminations in 30 days across 88 completed trips, 3.4%, below both the '4 or more' and the 'above 0.08' thresholds), and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0. No escalation ground under POL-NS-09 is open, so the case is decided on the merits at confidence 0.95, above the 0.70 floor.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
